Recomputed key numerical answers independently: 2.286 mV, -24 pA, -53 mV, 16 pA before/after, 0.0625 and 0.3164 failures, 0.104 detected success, 1.386/2.303 Poisson, 5.6 vesicles, 0.933 PPR, -63.16 mV, 1.083 mV cable, -37.03 mV chloride, 0.4096 relative calcium model. Reviewed all 50 answer mappings and scientific explanations; examples hypothetical.
